title: ChatbotResponseSchema
description: Schema for structured responses returned by the LLM.

answer.description: Main textual answer to the user, written in the requested language.

cards.description: Optional UI cards to display structured information such as nutrition facts, food items, or product summaries.

description.description: A concise explanation related to this card.

image_url.description: Optional image for the card (thumbnail or external URL).

source_id.description: Indicates the KB source (doc_id or URL) used for this card.

buttons.description: Optional follow-up options to guide the user within the chatbot.

label.description: What is shown on the button.

value.description: The message sent back to the chatbot when the button is clicked.
